title: The grid
question: Which way round is the 8 x 4 grid?
options: a. Rows are 4 lanes (lane 1 the top row, beside Track 1), columns are 8 scenes: Move's own Session Mode
b. As RemoteFM1's session view: columns 1-7 lanes, column 8 the scene pads, rows scenes (28 slots)
c. Rows are lanes with lane 1 the bottom row (as the kit's pad 1 bottom left)
why: Move's manual: each row a track's slots, each column a scene. Four lanes match 'a pad row a track' in the kit and give 8 variations a lane.

title: One loop a lane
question: Does a lane play one loop at a time?
options: a. Yes: launching another in the row replaces it at the bar (the 'choke per row')
b. No: every slot is free; choke groups set by hand
why: The session-view habit; it also makes scenes and stop simple.

title: Starting a recording
question: How do you record into a slot?
options: a. Tap an empty slot (records from the next bar); a slot held + Sample also replaces a full one
b. Only a slot held + Sample (the kit's gesture)
c. Record lit (armed) + tap an empty slot; without Record an empty slot only selects
why: A looper lives on speed. Undo removes a stray recording. Hold + Sample keeps the kit's gesture for replacing.

title: When it starts
question: When does a recording start?
options: a. At the next bar; stopped: armed, starts with Play
b. At once (no quantize), the length rounded later
c. At the next beat
why: Bar-exact loops need no trimming; arm-then-Play is what you asked of the sampler.

title: Loop length
question: What sets a recording's length?
options: a. Per lane: Open (default: tap again, ends at the next bar), 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 bars
b. One length for the whole looper
c. The first loop sets the length for every later one (pedal style)
why: Per lane, like Live's tracks: drums 1 bar, a pad 8 bars. Open is the sampler's default too.

title: Source
question: What does a lane record, and what is the default?
options: a. Per lane: Played (the firmware you play, default), Track 1-3 dry, Kit, Input, Mix (no loops, before FX), Loops (resample)
b. Always the master (with loops and FX)
c. One source for the whole looper
why: Looping the firmware you are playing is the common case; dry sources get FX again through the loop's own sends without doubling.

title: After recording
question: What happens when a recording ends?
options: a. It plays at once, seamlessly, from the bar it ended on
b. It waits, lit, until tapped
why: A looper's basic promise; matches Live and Push.

title: Tapping a loop
question: What does tapping a loop do?
options: a. Stopped loop: plays at the bar (double: now). Playing loop: stops at the bar (double: now)
b. Tap always (re)starts it; stop only by Delete, an empty slot or step 16
why: Toggle per pad; R2's 'same thing sooner' exception keeps it instant.

title: Launching scenes
question: How do you play a whole column?
options: a. The left step under each column plays that scene at the bar; step 16 stops all
b. Shift + any pad of the column
c. Slide a finger down the column (Move's own gesture)
why: Session view already uses the steps under each column; a slide clashes with the gated click rules.

title: Quantize
question: What quantizes launches and recordings?
options: a. The global Launch setting session view already uses
b. The looper's own setting (bar, beat, none)
why: One setting to learn.

title: Pages
question: Are these the Looper's pages (the jog turns them, as the kit's)?
options: a. Loops (lanes), Loop (wave, Start, Length, Pitch, Reverse, Warp), Record (Source, Length), Loop Mix, Looper Mix
b. Fewer: Loops and Loop, with mix settings on the Loop page's Shift knobs
why: Matches the kit's split of Pad Sample / Pad Mix / Kit Mix.

title: The Loops tab
question: How does the sampler's Loops tab work without the pads?
options: a. The grid in small; jog chooses a slot, click records / plays / stops it; Sample records; knobs 1-4 the lane levels; the pads stay the firmware's
b. A list of lanes (three rows), Left / Right the scene
why: You keep playing the firmware on the pads while looping with the jog.

title: Tempo change
question: Stage 1: repitch on tempo change (settled). Should Warp Off (no sync) exist too?
options: a. Yes: Warp Repitch (default) or Off (plays at its own rate, not synced)
b. No: every loop is synced
why: Off is useful for one-shot textures; Grains / Beats come in stage 2.

title: Mixing
question: How does the looper mix?
options: a. Its own bus beside the kit: loop level / pan / sends, then the Loops strip (Mixer column 5), the volume knob's master
b. Through the kit's bus
why: Your rule: every sound through the same path; one Loops strip, settled.

title: Where loops are kept
question: Where are the loops' files?
options: a. In the project's own folder, Kits/Projects/NN/Loops/, written when the recording ends
b. Only in RAM until the project is saved
c. In RemoteFM1's takes (dated folders)
why: Safe before the save, visible in Move's browser, moved with the project like the kit's copies.

title: Undo
question: What can Undo bring back?
options: a. One step: the last recording, delete, copy or clear
b. Several steps
why: As the kit; RAM per step is large for audio.

title: The looper's colour
question: Which colour marks the looper (Track 4, knobs, loops)?
options: b. White
c. One colour a lane
why: Free of the slots' orange, blue, yellow, the kit's pink and green (playing) and red (recording).

title: Capture
question: When does Capture (the last bars of a lane's source into an empty slot) come?
options: a. Stage 2
b. Stage 1
why: It needs a read of the recorder's always-listening ring; stage 1 stays small.

title: Overdub (stage 2)
question: How do you overdub?
options: a. Record held + a playing loop: layers from its next start until tapped again; Undo removes the layer
b. Tap the playing loop while Record is latched
why: Record is Move's own overdub button; held keeps it a deliberate act.

title: Stages
question: Is this split right?
options: a. Stage 1: grid, record, launch, scenes, pages, repitch, the strip, saving, the Loops tab, Copy / Delete / Undo. Stage 2: overdub, stretch, Capture, To Kit / To Takes / To Looper, launch modes, the page's web looper
b. Put the Loops tab in stage 2
why: The settled order puts overdub second; the tab is cheap once the engine exists.
